title: design: shared Misaki conversation engine for production and tuning lab
purpose: 会話や記憶・関係性を扱う処理の変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body: Design-only Draft PR. Proposes a single pure conversation pipeline shared by production and offline lab, with strict separation of canonical state, auth, quota and writes. Includes parity invariants, phased extraction and rollout gates. No runtime edits, no model calls, no production deployment. Coordinate with PR #85 (draft overview) and PR #86 (offline harness). Owner approval required before any paid Gemini calls or production rollout.

code_facts.expression: **Inside shared engine**: prompt assembly, Gemini message mapping, generation orchestration via an injected model port, parsing, reply problem detection, retry decision, expression rewrite and final cleanup. Relationship/emotion calculation must be pure and take snapshot input; if not yet pure, keep it outside and supply resolved guides.
